description: A warm, resource-driven Phaser archery game with three ranges, press-and-hold curved flight, animated launches and impacts, local best scores, and complete free-play replay and recovery loops. New wallet-funded runs remain gated until a Curve Arrow contract is deployed and the full Morpheus settlement path has production evidence; historical recovery stays available in the runtime.
description_zh: 明亮温暖、资源化的 Phaser 拐弯射箭游戏，拥有三种靶场、按住拐弯的飞行操控、放箭与命中动画、本地最佳成绩，以及完整的免费重玩与恢复流程。新的钱包付费对局将在 Curve Arrow 合约完成部署且完整 Morpheus 结算路径取得生产证据后开放；运行时仍保留历史对局恢复能力。
name: Curve Arrow

operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a range, loose an illustrated arrow, hold to bend its path over stone walls, release to level out, and save your local best. Free play never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Curve Arrow

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Free local play makes no oracle request. Historical recovery remains available, while new paid runs stay gated until a deployed contract and funded end-to-end settlement have production evidence.

tee.description: Free local play makes no TEE request. Morpheus-backed paid starts are not advertised until deployment, pool, and settlement validation are complete.

platform.description: Migrated to platform-game engine (shared mode). Legacy contract {} deprecated.
